title: When pleasure has no ending
meaning: Your skill at creating pleasure can become entangled with a demand to keep the evening endlessly full.
text: You can give shared leisure a pleasing shape and flavour: choosing treats, making yourselves comfortable and bringing beauty to an ordinary evening. This is the Empress in the physical position of Svadhisthana, turning a wish into something available to enjoy. The Empress in energy has a different vulnerability: wanting such abundance that no sense of lack could possibly remain. The Devil in emotions shows how tightly enjoyment can hold you. It feels so good that ending it almost seems like a deprivation, although nobody is taking that pleasure away.

Suppose you arrange a tasting evening at home. Comparing flavours, laughing at surprising combinations and choosing favourites is enjoyable. Yet several unopened boxes remain on the table, and the evening quietly begins to obey them. **Pleasure remains yours while you are free to finish.** Generous preparation gives you choices; it does not require tasting everything today. A few small portions you have actually shared can contain the impressions you most enjoy.

The difficulty begins when stopping seems ungrateful after all that effort. You continue for the sake of completeness, then expect the same enthusiasm from each other. An obligation to enjoy yourselves starts holding the occasion together. The more you have prepared, the harder it becomes to acknowledge having enough. What you made can have a future; this evening need not use up every available pleasure at once.
